date.as_written: samvat 769 poṣa-(2)kṛṣṇa-ṣaṣṭamyāyāṃ tithau utraphālguṇikṣatre saubhanayogya svamavārasare

notes: svārthaṃ leṣitā indicates Viśvantara caused the manuscript to be written for his own sake (commissioner/owner), though the cataloguer recorded him as scribe. 'noṃgabhota' appears to be his locality/residence.
